import asyncio,gc,hashlib,json,platform,resource,time,tracemalloc
from pathlib import Path
from terminal.stocks.sec_identity import parse_reference
from terminal.stocks.service import StockWorkspace
from terminal.stocks.test_workspace import SEC_ENV
from terminal.stocks.test_final import client,quote,packet
payload={str(i):{'ticker':f'GEN/{i}'if i%10==0 else f'GEN{i:05}','cik_str':i+1,'title':'Authored registry performance fixture'}for i in range(50000)}
raw=json.dumps(payload,separators=(',',':')).encode();assert len(raw)<=8388608
samples=[]
for rep in range(4):
 gc.collect();t=time.perf_counter();rows,integrity=parse_reference(payload);elapsed=time.perf_counter()-t
 assert len(rows)==45000 and integrity['excluded_rows']==5000
 if rep:samples.append({'seconds':elapsed,'source_entries_per_second':50000/elapsed})
 del rows
tracemalloc.start();decoded=json.loads(raw);rows,integrity=parse_reference(decoded);current,peak=tracemalloc.get_traced_memory();tracemalloc.stop()
async def snapshot():
 p={str(i):{'ticker':f'NEW{i}','title':'Authored registry issuer','cik_str':42+i}for i in range(4)}
 for i in range(40):p[str(i+4)]={'ticker':f'AUTH/{i}','title':'Authored unsupported reference','cik_str':100+i}
 async def fetch(*_):return json.dumps(p).encode()
 w=StockWorkspace(environment=SEC_ENV,fetcher=fetch);await w.refresh_identities();c=client();c.workspace.issuers=w.issuers;c.workspace.issuer_source=w.issuer_source;c.symbols=tuple(w.issuers);c.phase='SUBSCRIBED'
 t=time.perf_counter()
 for i in range(256):
  q=quote();q['S']=f'NEW{i%4}';q['bs']=i;c.process(packet(q))
 seconds=time.perf_counter()-t;s=c.view();size=len(json.dumps(s,separators=(',',':')).encode());assert size<1048576
 return {'symbols':4,'events':256,'source_exclusions':40,'source_diagnostic_examples':16,'snapshot_bytes':size,'frame_budget_bytes':1048576,'processing_seconds':seconds,'events_per_second':256/seconds,'classification':'AUTHORED_IN_PROCESS_NOT_EXCHANGE_THROUGHPUT'}
s=asyncio.run(snapshot())
cpu=next((line.split(':',1)[1].strip()for line in Path('/proc/cpuinfo').read_text().splitlines()if line.startswith('model name')),platform.processor())
r={'schema':'gig.atlas.final.source_measurements.v1','fixture':'INDEXED_AUTHORED_REGISTRY_50000_V1','fixture_sha256':hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest(),'generator_seed':None,'generator':'deterministic indexed rows;no RNG','input_bytes':len(raw),'source_entries':50000,'accepted':45000,'excluded':5000,'warmups':1,'repetitions':3,'samples':samples,'decode_and_parse_peak_tracked_bytes':peak,'whole_process_peak_rss_KiB':resource.getrusage(resource.RUSAGE_SELF).ru_maxrss,'msgpack_version':'.'.join(map(str,__import__('msgpack').version)),'python':platform.python_version(),'architecture':platform.machine(),'CPU':cpu,'snapshot':s,'limitations':['Synthetic single-process measurements,not market latency or SLA','Throughput repetitions exclude JSON decoding;memory pass includes decoding','RSS includes input,warmup and tracing instrumentation;not isolated production peak','No raw market data,observed source or persistence']}
Path('build/final-master/source-measurements.json').write_text(json.dumps(r,indent=2)+'\n');print(json.dumps(r,indent=2))
